text_block_list.text:
Activities toward realizing the "Grand 
Live Revival Project" were progressing 
steadily.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Please come watch the live show! Thank you 
so much~☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoops, was that the last flyer? Guess I'd 
better go restock—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: I brought it!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wah, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for your hard work! Let's get right 
into that special lesson you asked for the 
other day!
choice_data_list: I'm looking forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text: No, no, not in the slightest. Well then—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Sensei, also I've sent over all the 
dance videos you requested.

text_block_list.name: Dance Instructor
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that's a huge help! There's actually 
a group I've really wanted to reference 
for our next choreography!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... No, not at all. I'm simply doing 
what should be expected of me.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
All I can really do is offer support, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, it looks like the outdoor stage is 
open right now! Would it be okay if I did 
a quick guerilla live show!?"

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ! Yes! Let's definitely give it a try!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Thank you so much~! ............

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...No one... is here...! A star wasn't 
born after all...!"
choice_data_list:
It was just a trial run this time, a 
guerrilla live, so...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Until the day I can make everyone's 
hearts throb, Falco won't ever give up!!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: ......How could this happen...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Y-You're right! Let's make the next 
concert even bigger!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san's performance was flawless. The 
fact that a crowd didn't gather must be 
due to my poor planning...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
? Huh, no! This has nothing to do with 
that!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: "...? Was I mistaken?"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
That's right! It just means Falco didn't 
do enough to show everyone how much fun 
the concert would be!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's frustrating, but still! Let's 
think about how to win everyone's hearts 
for the actual live show!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: A performance... that captivates hearts.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Hey, you too, Trainer-san!
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's figure it out together!
Yeah, let's think about it together!

text_block_list.text:
And so, on the way back from our 
discussion about what to do next after the 
guerrilla live—

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
choice_data_list: You seem a little down, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah. S-Sorry! Let's do our best next time! 
Umm, next is——...

choice_data_list:
For now, why don't we go grab a bite to 
eat?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha... Yes. Then please, allow me to 
join you.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
choice_data_list:
Thanks for always handling the 
preparations.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
No, thank you! If anything, you've all 
been helping me this whole time!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Um... live performances really are 
difficult, aren't they?
choice_data_list:
Are you... not very good with live 
performances?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Ahaha. No, um... How should I put 
this...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I don't have much experience with Winning 
Lives.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what it takes to make a 
concert a success, or even what 
constitutes success in the first place.
choice_data_list:
If that's the case, why propose the Grand 
Live?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...I wanted to create a stage where 
everyone involved is smiling.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Even backstage, where the spotlight 
doesn't shine...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
......Right, that's true. I really need to 
work harder, don't I!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
I'm putting everything on the line for 
this project! I fully intend to do my best 
by leveraging everything I've learned on 
the job!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for inviting me out to eat! I'll 
get the bill for this!

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
First, starting today, I'm going to study 
what Falcon-san called "captivating 
concerts"!

Light Hello quickly settled the bill and 
rushed out of the shop, her shoulders 
still stiff with tension—

A few days later. While handing out flyers 
at the school gate for our 1st Live 
event...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The Grand Live. A live 
performance... A live, huh! Splendid!!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: T-Tachyon-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Ah, to think I overlooked this! In that 
research, the live concert factor has 
practically been left unexamined!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Congestion, synchronization, or perhaps a 
'swell'? Could this become a factor that 
influences not just neurotransmitters, but 
physical activation as well?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh... I look forward to our first day 
of observation. For the real deal, let us 
bring one more along—"her."

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh. W-Wait!? Does that mean you're 
willing to help me outâ!?"

And so, preparations toward the 1st Live 
continued to move forward—
